hero.title: Safe schools. Healthy children. Strong futures.
hero.text: Light for the Community works with vulnerable and conflict-affected communities so children can learn, heal, and dream again.

mission: Improving education, child well-being, nutrition and health through community action, advocacy and strategic partnerships.

project.title: Adima School Renovation
project.description: We are helping renovate Adima Primary and Secondary School with modern classrooms, reliable water access, and daily nutrition for children.

impact.title: Progress that children can feel every day.
impact.description: At ADIMA, practical improvements are making schools safer and healthier place to be. This is only the beginning and every partnership helps us reach further.
